text:
sam_customer: Hi team, after upgrading our app to @redwood/sdk v0.28.1 the chat create call is 404ing.

sam_customer: Code: 
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
await client.chat.create({ sessionId: 'sess_123', model: 'rw-1' })
```

sam_customer: Error: { status: 404, message: "No route for chat.create" }

alex_support: thanks — can you paste npm/yarn lock lines and the exact request/headers? also which environment (prod/staging)?

sam_customer: staging. npm ls @redwood/sdk:
```
project@1.0.0 /app
└─┬ @redwood/sdk@0.28.1
  └── (empty)
```

sam_customer: headers: `Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx`, `content-type: application/json`

alex_support: ok, pinging eng-runtime. jessica any known API surface changes around chat routes?

jessica_eng: we rolled a minor routing change last week — the internal endpoint names were standardized. `chat.create` was renamed to `chat.start` and `sessionId` -> `conversationId` in the newer API. we published a migration note but sorry if it didn't reach all SDK users.

mike_sdk: we tried to keep backward compat in the SDK but the 0.28.1 publish missed the alias layer for chat due to a packaging race. working on a 0.28.2 hotfix that reintroduces the mapping and a compatibility header `X-Redwood-SDK-Legacy: chat.create`.

alex_support: temporary workaround for you: call the new route directly using the SDK low-level `client.request`:
```js
await client.request('POST', '/v1/chat.start', { conversationId: 'sess_123', model: 'rw-1' })
```

sam_customer: tried that — works, thanks. can you share repro so we can roll back SDK pin in our infra?

mike_sdk: we'll cut 0.28.2 in ~30m. if you need a quick patch, set env `RW_LEGACY_ROUTES=true` for the service; that toggles the client shim until you can upgrade.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered for @redwood/sdk@0.28.2 -> npm (build #214)

sam_customer: :thumbsup: thx. how should we track this for billing/incident?

alex_support: I'll open a support ticket and tag eng-runtime + SDK team, and add a note for billing to ignore duplicate retries if any. sending logs and repro steps now.

jessica_eng: FYI we'll also add a migration header in the API that returns `x-rd-suggested-sdk: 0.28.2` when clients hit old routes.

sam_customer: appreciated. leaving staging pinned to 0.28.1 for a bit while we test 0.28.2 in CI.

mike_sdk: patch published. please `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.28.2` and test; ping here if anything else.

sam_customer: upgraded to 0.28.2 — tests all green. thanks everyone :tada:
